// SubagentStop resolver. Reads agent_transcript_path from the payload and
// reports the DISTINCT message.model values over that transcript's assistant
// rows. The outcome lives in ONE field, `outcome`, never in a prefix, which is
// the defect the earlier model-observability probe reported against its own
// script.
import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
const out = process.env.TIPHYS_RESOLVE_LOG
let raw = ''
process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8')
process.stdin.on('data', (c) => { raw += c })
process.stdin.on('end', () => {
  let p = null
  try { p = JSON.parse(raw) } catch { p = null }
  const rec = {
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
    outcome: 'unset',
    agent_id: p?.agent_id ?? null,
    agent_type: p?.agent_type ?? null,
    agent_transcript_path: p?.agent_transcript_path ?? null,
    parent_transcript_path: p?.transcript_path ?? null,
    models: [],
    assistant_rows: 0,
    last_assistant_message: typeof p?.last_assistant_message === 'string' ? p.last_assistant_message.slice(0, 120) : null
  }
  if (!p) rec.outcome = 'fail-unparseable-payload'
  else if (!p.agent_transcript_path) rec.outcome = 'fail-no-agent-transcript-path'
  else if (!existsSync(p.agent_transcript_path)) rec.outcome = 'fail-agent-transcript-path-not-readable'
  else {
    const seen = new Set()
    let n = 0
    for (const line of readFileSync(p.agent_transcript_path, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
      if (!line.trim()) continue
      let row = null
      try { row = JSON.parse(line) } catch { continue }
      const m = row?.message?.model
      if (row?.type === 'assistant' && typeof m === 'string') { n += 1; seen.add(m) }
    }
    rec.assistant_rows = n
    rec.models = [...seen].sort()
    rec.outcome = n === 0 ? 'fail-no-assistant-model-rows' : 'resolved'
  }
  if (out) appendFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(rec) + '\n')
  process.exit(0)
})
